lines.say: A customer paid four hundred eighty thousand dollars, then quietly left.
Eight years. Sixty thousand dollars a year, paid on time, all eight years.
They never complained once, and never demanded a damn meeting.
Then last year, their usage fell by half.
The vendor never asked why. Its only message in eighteen months was an upsell.
So they quit, and signed with a competitor.
On paper, a perfect customer. In real life, a year of leaving in plain sight.
Customers never announce it, they just go quiet.
Your regulars do the same shit. Quiet for three weeks, then gone, and you never got a text.
Message Health spots the drop-off and texts them first, while they're still yours.
Comment KEEP to get a full retention audit.
